changelog: Notes+ 13: folders and an archive, share notes by link, invite links for group notes, 13 note colours, a theme of your own, pictures in lists, mind maps with several central ideas, and vault backups that only ever add (with Sync now). Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ for Windows 13: many windows, Ctrl+F and zoom in notes, folders and an archive, share links, themes, and vault backups that only ever add.
